pipes.guideTitle: Comprehensive Guide: Planning and Installation of K Aqua PP-R & PPRCT Pipe Systems
pipes.guideText:
Comprehensive Guide: Planning, Materials Science and Installation of K Aqua PP-R & PPRCT Pipe Systems

Choosing the right pipe material is the crucial foundation for the longevity, operational reliability and energy efficiency of modern building and industrial infrastructures. Our PP-R and PPRCT pipe systems, manufactured in Germany (Waldsolms), offer the future-proof alternative to conventional metal pipes made of copper, steel or brass thanks to their excellent thermal, chemical and mechanical properties.

Whether in domestic engineering for drinking water and heating networks, in industrial plant construction, in cooling systems or in shipbuilding, K Aqua pipes represent uncompromising German engineering and ensure absolutely leak-free and maintenance-free operation for decades.

Material Innovation: A Direct Comparison of PP-R and PPRCT

While standard Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) already exhibits excellent properties regarding corrosion resistance and hygiene, the advanced PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymer with Modified Crystallinity Temperature resistance) sets new standards in piping technology. Through targeted modification of the crystal structure during the polymerisation process, PPRCT offers significantly higher compressive strength at elevated operating temperatures of up to 95°C.

This material advantage makes it possible to produce pipes with significantly lower wall thicknesses (higher SDR classes) at the same nominal pressure. The results for the user are outstanding:

  • Increased hydraulic flow: A larger internal diameter increases flow volume by up to 17% compared to standard PP-R pipes.
  • Reduced pipe weight: Material savings significantly simplify transport and handling on site.
  • Higher pressure reserves: Maximum safety reserves even during peak loads in continuous hot water use.

Fibre Composite Technology (K-Fiber) for Minimal Linear Expansion

A central aspect when planning hot water and heating pipes is the thermal linear expansion of plastic pipes. K Aqua addresses this challenge with its innovative K-Fiber composite technology. The three-layer K-Fiber pipes feature a middle polypropylene layer reinforced with high-strength glass fibres.

This mechanical stabilisation reduces the linear coefficient of thermal expansion to precisely 0.035 mm/(m·K), which corresponds to a reduction in thermal linear expansion of around 75% compared to non-reinforced solid plastic pipes. For specialist planners and installers, this means:

  • Fewer expansion compensators: Significant savings on bending legs and expansion loops in the pipe run.
  • Larger fixing intervals: Savings on pipe clamps and fixed points during route layout.
  • Form-stable installation: No sagging of pipes in open routes or risers.

Homogeneous Polyfusion Welding: Leak Security for 50+ Years

The core of the K Aqua pipe system is the inseparable, material-locking connection technology via thermal polyfusion. During the welding process, the pipe end and the socket of the fitting are heated to exactly 260°C using an electronically controlled welding device. The polymer chains of both components melt at the joining surfaces.

When joined together, the melted macromolecules interlock completely at the molecular level. After cooling, a homogeneous, monolithic material structure is formed without seams, adhesives or elastic seals. Because no rubber O-rings or mechanical press connections are used, ageing damage, resinification or embrittlement of seals are a thing of the past. The welded joint withstands the same pressures as the pipe itself.

Hydraulics, Hygiene and Environmental Compatibility

Drinking water safety and energy efficiency are top priorities at K Aqua. The mirror-smooth inner surface of our PP-R and PPRCT pipes has an extremely low roughness of just k = 0.007 mm. This effectively prevents the adhesion of limescale deposits (incrustation) and stops the formation of breeding grounds for biofilms and legionella.

In addition, polypropylene is physiologically completely harmless, tasteless, odourless, and free of heavy metals and plasticisers. K Aqua pipe systems are certified worldwide according to the strictest testing standards (including DVGW, KIWA, WRAS). The system is also ecologically convincing: the polymer is 100% recyclable and has an excellent life cycle assessment in the manufacturing process compared to metal pipes.

Important Installation and Planning Notes

To ensure flawless function over the guaranteed lifespan of 50 years, the following points must be observed during installation:

  • Pressure testing: After completion of the installation, the pipe network must be subjected to a pressure test in accordance with DIN 1988 / DIN EN 806.
  • Thermal insulation: Pipes for hot water and heating must be professionally insulated in accordance with applicable energy saving regulations (e.g. GEG) to minimise heat losses.
  • UV protection: When installed exposed outdoors, UV-protected pipes must be used, or suitable covers must be provided.

faq.q: What differentiates PPRCT from conventional PP-R in piping systems?
faq.a: PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymer with Modified Crystallinity Temperature resistance) possesses a specifically modified crystal structure that enables higher pressure resistance at elevated operating temperatures. This allows thinner-walled pipes to be used at the same nominal pressure, increasing the internal diameter and hydraulic flow capacity by up to 17%.

faq.q: How does K-Fiber composite technology reduce thermal linear expansion?
faq.a: Our K-Fiber pipes feature an integrated middle layer of glass fibre-reinforced polypropylene. This layer mechanically stabilises the pipe and lowers the expansion coefficient to approx. 0.035 mm/(m·K). This represents a 75% reduction in thermal linear expansion compared to standard plastic pipes.

faq.q: Are K Aqua PP-R pipe systems certified for drinking water?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua pipe systems meet the strictest testing and hygiene requirements of international certification bodies such as DVGW, KIWA, and WRAS. The material is completely harmless, tasteless and odourless, and effectively prevents limescale and biofilm formation.

faq.q: How is an absolutely leak-free welded joint created?
faq.a: The connection is made via thermal polyfusion at 260°C. The pipe and fitting melt together on a molecular level to form a homogeneous, inseparable unit. Because no error-prone rubber seals or press fittings are used, the weld remains completely tight for over 50 years.

faq.q: What pressure ratings and dimensions are available for K Aqua pipes?
faq.a: K Aqua offers pipe systems in pressure ratings SDR 6, SDR 7.4, SDR 9, and SDR 11 (PN10 to PN25) as well as in outer diameters from 20 mm to 250 mm. This allows for both intricate floor distributions and massive main and riser lines to be realised.

The precise control and isolation of material flows are essential in modern water and heating networks. K Aqua shut-off valves and armatures combine the longevity of polypropylene with the precision of metallic sealing and actuating mechanisms.

What you need to know when integrating PP-R valves:

  • Dead space-free design: To prevent water stagnation and contamination (e.g. legionella), our valves are flow-optimised and hygienically designed, making them ideal for sensitive drinking water installations.
  • Pressure and temperature stability: The massive valve bodies and high-quality brass or PP balls guarantee a 100% seal, even under extreme pressure surges and high flow temperatures.
  • Maintenance friendliness: Even after many years of continuous use, K Aqua ball valves and inclined seat valves can be operated smoothly and precisely thanks to Teflon-coated sealing elements.

For maximum plant availability, we recommend strategically positioning the valves during the planning phase so that maintenance work and flushing procedures can be carried out without widespread network interruptions.

weldInSaddles.guideTitle: Installation Guide: Flexibility through Weld-in Saddles
weldInSaddles.guideText:
The modification or expansion of existing industrial and commercial pipe networks is often associated with considerable effort. Here, K Aqua weld-in saddles offer an efficient and extremely safe solution for creating subsequent branches without interrupting the line.

Key technical advantages at a glance:

  • Minimal installation time: Instead of cutting the main pipe and installing conventional T-pieces, the pipe is simply drilled with precision and the saddle welded on. This drastically reduces installation costs.
  • Maintenance of system integrity: Through polyfusion, the weld-in saddle bonds inseparably with the pipe wall, allowing the system to retain its original pressure and temperature resistance (up to PN 25).
  • Flexible connection options: Available as a pure plastic branch or with an integrated metal thread (F/M), saddles enable the direct connection of sensors, pressure gauges or branch lines in the tightest of spaces.

To ensure a flawless weld, the use of special K Aqua drilling and welding tools is strictly necessary, as they guarantee the exact milling depth and heating area for a perfect connection.

accessories.guideTitle: Expert Guide: K Aqua Accessories for Standard-Compliant Installations
accessories.guideText:
A high-quality pipe system requires equally high-quality accessories. The K Aqua range includes all essential components to ensure longevity, safety, and compliance with all building physics standards.

The most important aspects regarding the correct use of our accessories:

  • Compensation for linear expansion: Plastic pipes expand during temperature changes. The targeted use of our thermodynamic pipe clamps as fixed and sliding points safely absorbs these movements and protects the system from damaging internal stresses. This is particularly crucial in industrial plants and risers, where uncontrolled expansion could lead to structural damage.
  • Tight flange connections: For transitions to large valves, pumps or tanks, our loose flanges and precisely matched EPDM flat seals offer absolute safety under high contact pressures and continuous vibrations. They guarantee a seamless, liquid-tight connection, thereby preventing potentially disastrous leaks in critical infrastructures.
  • Repair solutions: With our innovative repair plug, accidentally drilled pipes (e.g. on construction sites) can be homogeneously welded in minutes, restoring the pipe's full mechanical load capacity. A complete replacement of the line section is therefore unnecessary.

In addition to compensation and tightness, insulation and fire protection play a central role in professional installation. The K Aqua accessory range is designed to minimise thermal losses and meet the highest safety standards. Our special seals and fastening elements are designed to effectively dampen sound transmission and prevent structure-borne noise propagation in masonry.

By exclusively using genuine K Aqua accessories, you secure full system warranty and avoid costly defects caused by incompatible third-party products. Invest in uncompromising quality to guarantee the trouble-free operation of your piping system for decades.

faq.q: Are the accessories suitable for hot and cold water?
faq.a: Yes, our accessories such as pipe clamps and flat seals are designed for use in cold water, hot water and heating systems and exhibit excellent thermal stability.
To claim the full K Aqua system warranty, it is mandatory to use genuine accessories. Third-party components can lead to leakage problems or mechanical failures.

faq.q: Are there special accessories for industrial use?
faq.a: Yes, our range includes heavy-duty loose flanges with steel cores, EPDM special seals, and reinforced pipe clamps that can effortlessly withstand extreme industrial loads.

tools.guideText:
The quality of a plastic pipe installation stands and falls with the precision of the tools used. K Aqua welding and cutting tools are specifically tailored to the thermoplastic properties of PP-R and PPRCT to achieve flawless results.

Why professional equipment is indispensable:

  • Flawless preparation: An absolutely square and burr-free cut is the basic prerequisite for a tight weld seam. Our pipe cutters and cold circular saws prevent material compression and micro-cracks.
  • Thermodynamic precision: The microprocessor-controlled socket welding devices maintain the ideal joining temperature of 260°C consistently, even in adverse weather conditions, reliably preventing polymer degradation.
  • Automated safety: For large nominal sizes, our computer-controlled butt welding and electrofusion machines eliminate human error by fully automatically regulating pressure, time, and temperature, documenting them digitally for building inspection.

Regular maintenance and cleaning of the Teflon-coated heating mandrels are essential to ensure a homogeneous melt and permanently resilient, leak-free pipe networks.

intro.title: Safety is no coincidence. It is calculable.
intro.lead: When international general contractors plan billion-dollar projects, they don't trust promises, they trust hard facts. We set the standard that the rest of the world follows.
intro.text1: For decades, we have been combining craftsman's pride with state-of-the-art, highly automated manufacturing technology at our main plant in the heart of Germany. Every elbow, every socket, every tee bears the unmistakable DNA of German engineering. Deployed in the harshest deserts, most extreme climate zones and most demanding industrial plants in the world, our material proves itself anew every day.
intro.text2: The fusion of macromolecules in our PP-R system creates a pipe network without weak points. There are no sealing rings that can corrode, no glued joints that can be attacked by chemicals. The pipe and fitting are thermally fused into a single, inseparable workpiece. This is the absolute definition of safety.

sticky.title: The Anatomy of Reliability.
sticky.lead: A deep dive into the physical and chemical properties that make our fittings the global benchmark.

items.title: The Molecular Structure
items.desc: Our fittings are based on a highly cross-linked PP-R Polypropylene Random Copolymer. Through controlled temperature-pressure profiles during extrusion, we achieve an isotropic crystal structure. The result: unprecedented resistance to stress cracking and extreme temperature fluctuations.

items.title: Thermoplastic Precision
items.desc: Every fitting undergoes a thermoplastic injection moulding process with cavity tolerances in the micrometre range. This ensures that the melt indices match perfectly when welded with our pipes, resulting in a homogeneous, inseparable and 100% leak-free material bond.

items.title: Zero Fault Tolerance
items.desc: We leave nothing to chance. Using ultrasonic wall thickness measurement, hydrostatic internal pressure creep tests, and DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry), every batch is analysed. Only material that exceeds our internal standards (which are well above DIN EN ISO 15874) is approved.

items.title: Cavitation Resistance
items.desc: The flow-optimised internal geometry of our fittings effectively prevents pressure drops and cavitation, even at extreme flow velocities in industrial risers. This minimises noise emissions and protects the system from abrasive wear from within.

bento.title: Specifications beyond the standard.
bento.lead: While the industry sees standards as a goal, we view them merely as the absolute minimum.

items.title: DIN EN ISO 15874
items.desc: Full compliance and testing for plastic piping systems for hot and cold water installations.

items.title: PN 20 / PN 25

items.title: Chemical Inertness
items.desc: Outstanding resistance to aggressive media. pH-independent (pH 1 to 14) for industrial use.

items.title: Acoustic Damping
items.desc: The inherent elasticity of the PP-R material absorbs structure-borne sound and reduces flow noise to an absolute minimum, ideal for luxury hotels and hospitals.

timeline.title: The Genesis Process
timeline.desc: From molecular raw mass to indestructible component. A look into our highly automated manufacturing matrix.

items.title: Granule Selection
items.text: Only highly pure, pre-synthesised polypropylene granules from premium European refineries pass our incoming inspection.

items.title: Thermal Conditioning
items.text: Prior to injection moulding, the granules are thermally stabilised to eliminate residual moisture and guarantee a homogeneous melt.

items.title: High-Pressure Injection Moulding
items.text: In fully automated, robot-assisted injection moulding cells, we shape the material under enormous pressure into flawless fittings.

items.title: Cooling Matrix

By adding special antioxidants and thermal stabilisers to our PP-R matrix, thermal-oxidative ageing is massively delayed. Even at continuous flow temperatures of 70°C and pressure loads of 10 bar, we guarantee a service life of over half a century. That is not marketing. That is applied polymer physics.

hero.title: PP-R & PPRCT Pipes from d20 to d630
hero.lead: K Aqua PP-R pipes and PPRCT multilayer pipes for drinking water, heating and industry: Mono and fibre-composite versions in all pressure ratings, manufactured in Germany according to DIN 8077/8078. Available from d20 to d630 for permanently tight connections.

sticky.title: Polymer Engineering in Perfection.
sticky.lead: The molecular structure of our PP-R and PPRCT pipes has been optimised for extreme thermo-mechanical loads. A masterpiece of German engineering.

items.title: PPRCT Multilayer Architecture
items.desc: Our latest generation of PPRCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymers with modified Crystallinity and Temperature resistance) pipes features an integrated glass fibre compound layer. This reduces thermal linear expansion by up to 75% compared to standard PP-R pipes, while drastically increasing pressure resistance at high temperatures. Thinner wall thicknesses with increased flow capacity are the result.

items.title: Homogeneous Welding
items.desc: Unlike press fittings or glued joints, we utilise the polyfusion welding process. Pipe and fitting fuse at 260°C into a single, inseparable molecular unit. The system operates entirely without O-rings or mechanical seals. The joint is physically stronger than the pipe itself: a 100% leak-free lifespan is guaranteed.

items.title: Absolute Freedom from Corrosion
items.desc: Metallic systems succumb to aggressive water qualities, low pH levels or high chloride content. K Aqua polymer pipes are completely inert. Pitting, crevice corrosion, galvanic corrosion or incrustations are physically impossible. The pipe friction loss (roughness value k=0.007 mm) remains at day one levels even after 50 years of operation, massively reducing pump energy.

items.title: Thermal and Acoustic Insulation
items.desc: Thanks to the low thermal conductivity of PP-R (0.24 W/mK) compared to steel (50 W/mK) or copper (380 W/mK), condensation on cooling systems is significantly delayed and heat losses in heating systems are minimised. Furthermore, our thick-walled polymer pipes efficiently absorb flow noises and water hammers, perfecting acoustic comfort in high-rises and hotels.

timeline.title: Zero Fault Tolerance
timeline.desc: Every centimetre of our pipes is monitored during the extrusion process. From granule to finished product: Quality Made in Germany.

items.title: Premium Raw Material
items.text: We exclusively process highly pure PP-R and PPRCT granules from the world's leading polymer manufacturers. Every batch undergoes a Melt Flow Rate (MFR) test and an Oxidative Induction Time (OIT) measurement in our in-house laboratory prior to release for extrusion.

items.title: Precision Extrusion
items.text: Our state-of-the-art extrusion lines manufacture 3-layer fibre-composite pipes with micrometre precision. Real-time ultrasonic wall thickness measurement across 360° ensures that even with SDR 6 pipes, the minimum permissible tolerances are not undercut.

items.title: Thermal Conditioning
items.text: Immediately after extrusion, the pipes are gradually cooled down in specially tempered water baths. This gentle cooling process prevents internal residual stresses in the material and ensures the highest dimensional accuracy across all dimensions.

items.title: 100% Traceability
items.text: Every pipe receives an indelible laser imprint with exact batch and production time details. Even after decades in the wall, the origin of every K Aqua pipe can be traced seamlessly back to the granule batch.

items.title: Testing & Release
items.text: Hydraulic burst pressure test at 95°C for over 1000 hours. Tensile tests, notched bar impact strength and toxicological safety testing. The product only leaves our facility if it exceeds all standards (DIN 8077/8078, EN ISO 15874).

bento.title: A dimension for every requirement.
bento.lead: Scalable from d20 house connections up to d500 industrial risers. Our system grows with the dimensions of your project.

items.title: Dimensions from d20 to d500
items.desc: A complete portfolio of pipes and fittings. Whether tees, reducers, or flange connections in massive dimensions, we supply the complete system from a single source. No compromises on hydraulics.

items.title: Drinking Water Hygiene

items.title: UV-Resistant Exterior Pipes

hero.title: Transition Fittings: Secure from Metal to PP-R
hero.lead: Brass meets polymer: K Aqua transition fittings connect existing metal pipes permanently tight and corrosion-free with the PP-R system, tested far beyond the standard.

intro.title: Where worlds collide.
intro.lead: The transition from rigid metallic piping systems to modern thermoplastic networks is the Achilles heel of any building and industrial installation. This is where maximum thermal and mechanical shear forces act.

sticky.title: Anatomy of Indestructibility.
sticky.lead: We view a transition fitting not as an accessory, but as a highly complex mechanical instrument. Every millimetre of wall thickness, every thread pitch is the result of countless Finite Element Analyses (FEA).

items.title: The Symbiosis of Metal and Polymer
items.desc: Our transition fittings combine the relentless mechanical strength of dezincification-resistant CW617N brass with the chemical inertness of PPRCT. This material fusion is not created by simple pressing, but through a thermo-mechanical injection moulding process that achieves an inseparable molecular interlocking.

items.title: Extreme Torsion and Torque
items.desc: A critical failure criterion for standard fittings is torque overload during installation. K Aqua transitions integrate a patented hexagonal anchoring profile in the plastic jacket. The result: Over 300 Nm guaranteed torsional resistance without delamination of the boundary layer.

items.title: Thermal Expansion Coefficients in Equilibrium
items.desc: Metals and plastics expand differently under temperature fluctuations (Δα). Through precisely calculated micro-expansion joints in the brass insert, our fittings compensate for extreme shocks from -20°C to +95°C in milliseconds, absolutely leak-free.

items.title: Zero-Tolerance Quality Control
items.desc: Every single hybrid component undergoes a fully automated helium leak test and an optical 3D measurement. If the limit value of 10^-5 mbar·l/s is even slightly approached, our system rigorously rejects the part. German Engineering tolerates no compromises.

bento.title: Architecture of Performance.
bento.lead: When planning mega-projects with tens of thousands of connections, statistical reliability is the most important ROI. K Aqua gives you the physical guarantee for this.

items.title: DZR Brass Core
items.desc: Dezincification-resistant brass grade CW617N (according to DIN EN 12164) eliminates the risk of selective corrosion in aggressive water qualities.

items.title: Anti-Rotation Design
items.desc: Polygonal undercuts form a geometric lock that absorbs extreme tightening torques without straining the plastic jacket.

items.title: Deep-Drawn Thread
items.desc: Conical and cylindrical ISO 7/1 and ISO 228 threads, machine-cut with a tolerance of ±0.01mm for perfect tightness.

items.title: PPRCT Matrix
items.desc: The highly crystalline structure of our Polypropylene Random Copolymer offers outstanding long-term creep resistance at high temperatures.

timeline.title: The Manufacturing Cycle
timeline.desc: A look into our manufactory. The journey from raw material to tested hybrid fitting is an orchestra of heat, pressure, and ruthless precision.

items.title: Blank Machining (CW617N)
items.text: The brass is pressed into high-precision dies at 750°C, followed by CNC-controlled machining in the micrometre range to create the sealing profile.

items.title: Surface Passivation
items.text: To eliminate galvanic corrosion, the threaded inserts go through a multi-stage passivation process in electrolytic ultrasonic baths.

items.title: Injection Moulding
items.text: In high-pressure injection moulding machines (2,000 bar), the molten PPRCT encloses the brass. The plastic completely fills every undercut.

items.title: Controlled Cooling
items.text: A programmed, step-by-step temperature reduction prevents internal stresses in the plastic lattice and ensures the concentric shape accuracy of the fitting.

items.title: Pressure & Torsion Testing
items.text: Random burst tests up to 120 bar as well as fatigue tests simulate 50 years of the most aggressive industrial continuous load.

stats.title: Hard Facts.
stats.lead: We don't just test to standards. We define them. Our internal test protocols exceed the requirements of DVGW, SKZ, and ISO by up to 300%.

co2.guideText:
Sustainability and LCA (Life Cycle Assessment)

Choosing the right piping system has a significant impact on the carbon footprint of a building or industrial facility. The K-Aqua CO2 Calculator provides a comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) in accordance with EN 15804 standards. This analysis covers the entire lifecycle: from raw material extraction and product manufacturing (Phases A1-A3) to transport and installation (Phases A4-A5), the use phase (Phase B), and end-of-life (Phase C).

Compared to traditional metal pipes like copper or steel, K-Aqua's PP-R and PPRCT pipes boast a much more favorable environmental footprint. The lower energy required for plastic extrusion and the significantly reduced weight drastically lower CO2 emissions during production and transport. Furthermore, the mirror-smooth inner surface (roughness of just 0.007 mm) ensures extremely low flow resistance. According to the Darcy-Weisbach equation, this means circulation pumps require significantly less energy (electricity) to move fluids through the system.

Particularly during the use phase (Phase B), which for piping systems often lasts 50 years or longer, these energy savings translate into massive CO2 and cost reductions (Total Cost of Ownership, TCO). Even at the end of its lifespan (Phase C), polypropylene offers environmental benefits, as it is 100% recyclable and can be reused in a circular economy (Module D). Use this calculator to accurately and transparently quantify the ecological and economic savings potential of your K-Aqua project.

items.title: High-Pressure Extrusion Dynamics
items.desc: Thermoplastic deformation in our plants is subject to precise temperature control accurate to 0.1 °C. This crystalline perfection guarantees a flawless, homogeneous molecular structure that absolutely excludes microscopic cracking (stress cracking) even under extreme pressure and temperature fluctuations. When the material leaves our extruder, it is no longer a simple plastic; it is an industrial monolith.

items.title: Hydrostatic Stress Tests
items.desc: In our testing labouratories, every pipe is subjected to a hydrostatic simulation that exceeds real conditions many times over. We apply internal pressures that are beyond any normative requirement (up to 100 bar, depending on the SDR class). This ensures the integrity of the welds and the molecular elasticity of the PP-R material over a projected lifespan of more than 50 years in critical infrastructures.

items.title: Polyfusion Welding Technology
items.desc: Connections are the weak point in conventional systems. K Aqua eliminates this risk through polyfusion. At the molecular level, pipe and fitting fuse into an inseparable, continuous unit. There are no threads to corrode, no seals that can fail. The result is a piping system that behaves as if it were cast from a single piece.

items.title: Cavitation Resistance & Fluid Mechanics
items.desc: Thanks to an ultra-smooth inner wall (roughness < 0.007 mm), K Aqua pipes minimize flow resistance to almost zero. This prevents the formation of biofilms and eliminates micro-cavitational effects at high flow velocities. Pressure losses in the system are drastically reduced, maximizing the energy efficiency of connected pumping systems on an industrial scale.

bento.title: Technical Parameters.
bento.lead: The most important vocabulary of industrial pipeline technology, distilled to its essence.

items.title: PP-R (Polypropylene Random Copolymer)
items.desc: The molecular basis. A highly crystalline thermoplastic polymer that offers exceptional resistance to high temperatures and pressures. It is the DNA of our longevity.

items.title: Linear Thermal Expansion
items.desc: The change in length of the material during temperature changes. Our fiber-reinforced pipes reduce this value to an absolute minimum (α = 0.035 mm/mK), which enormously increases structural stability in shafts.

items.title: Creep Rupture Strength
items.desc: The ability of the system to withstand constant internal pressure at specific temperatures over decades without deforming or bursting. K Aqua pipes are calibrated for 50+ years.

items.title: Pressure Loss Coefficient
items.desc: A mathematical value that describes the energy loss of the flow due to friction on the inner pipe wall. Thanks to nano-smooth surfaces, this value is marginalized in K Aqua systems.

items.title: SDR (Standard Dimension Ratio)
items.desc: The ratio between the outer diameter (d) and the wall thickness (s). An SDR 6 pipe withstands massively higher pressures than an SDR 11 pipe. The correct choice is crucial for system design.

conclusion.title: Decomposition Resistance in Extreme Cases.
conclusion.p1: In industrial applications, it is not normal operation that determines the quality of a piping system, but stability at the limits. Chemical corrosion, cavitation from water hammer, and thermal shocks are the natural enemies of conventional installations.
conclusion.p2: The K Aqua Matrix isolates the fluid medium from the environment with an inert barrier layer. There is no ion exchange. Metallic systems degrade from the moment water flows through them. They sacrifice themselves to function. Our PP-R system remains flawless inside even after decades.
conclusion.p3: The concept of Environmental Stress Cracking Resistance (ESCR) is of central importance in polymer chemistry. We modify the molecular weight of our copolymer so that it cushions load peaks instead of breaking under them. The result is a system that absorbs shocks, vibrations, and structural settlements.
conclusion.p4: Anyone who has understood the terminology of pipeline technology also understands why compromises here can mean ruin. German Engineering is not an empty promise, but the sum of precise, physical parameters that we manifest in every single centimeter of our production.

faqs.q: Can I also make a request as a private individual?
